title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, sharing prerequisite, role-group controls and described integration are supported. The claim that alerts were previously visible only to IRM role groups remains unconfirmed; the sharing path and Defender-role wording need small clarifications, and several checklist controls have no table row. Earlier verifier directions were treated as history, not evidence.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The integration requires an administrator to turn on data sharing, represented as admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: Data sharing with other security solutions must be turned on in the Data sharing settings in Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management.

claims.claim: The sharing control is reached at Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Insider Risk Management > Data sharing > Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions.
claims.quote: In Insider Risk Management settings, select the Data sharing setting. Under the Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions section, turn on the setting.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct section but omits the switch. Extend it to 'Settings > Insider Risk Management > Data sharing > Sharing data with other Microsoft security solutions > Share user risk details with other security solutions'; the switch label is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-xdr/irm-investigate-alerts-defender, already cited.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API or PowerShell operation that changes the IRM Data sharing setting as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: IRM Data sharing Set PolicyConfig Security Compliance PowerShell API; "insider risk" "sharing" "Set-PolicyConfig"; "Insider Risk Management" "data sharing" "PowerShell". Read share-data, settings and integration pages/results; APIs export/read data, not this switch.

claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to. The Member parameter specifies who you want to add to the role group. User ID or user principal name (UPN)
